estimates.view_summary.recommendations.Definition

Describes the parameters used to retrieve recommendation summary.

Available as lseg.data.content.estimates.view_summary.recommendations.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    package: str | Package,
    use_field_names_in_headers: bool = False,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes Single instrument or list of instruments.
package str | Package Yes Packages of the content that are subsets in terms of breadth (number of fields) and depth (amount of history) of the overall content set.
use_field_names_in_headers bool No False Boolean that indicates whether or not to display field names in the headers.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Specifies the parameters that will be merged with the request.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

from lseg.data.content import estimates
definition = estimates.view_summary.recommendations.Definition(universe="IBM.N", package=estimates.Package.BASIC)
response = definition.get_data()
